description: Trinkwasserschutzgebiete im Landkreis Nienburg/Weser is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The designation of water protection areas (WSG) serves to protect groundwater and thus drinking water resources. In these areas, no pollutants may enter the subsoil and groundwater through above-ground use. A WSG consists of different water protection areas in order to protect the groundwater in the catchment area of a water abstraction from adverse effects. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water protection areas in the district of Nienburg/Weser" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert, opendata. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
